pairs.question: Quis est homo qui uult uitam, et diligit uidere dies bonos?
pairs.derivation: Augustine quotes the scriptural question (Ps 33:13) and explicitly answers it later with the speech-tag 'respondebimus': 'tunc uero interrogati: [quis est homo qui uult uitam]? respondebimus nos uelle uitam, si etiam sub ipso percussoris ictu...'. Question taken in its full opening form; section-marker brackets [] stripped. Answer: framing verb 'respondebimus' (narrates the reply) dropped, leaving the operative direct response 'nos uelle uitam' (capitalized, terminal stop normalized); the trailing conditional clause 'si etiam sub ipso percussoris ictu ueritatem seruabimus...' is elaboration, not the answer to 'who wants life', so it is cut at the first full stop.
